title: Risk Assessment in Testicular Tumors (Including Germ Cell And Sex Cord Stromal Tumors).
snippet: Testicular tumors are relatively rare, yet represent one of the most common solid neoplasms in young adult males. They are a heterogeneous group of neoplasms with distinct biological behaviors and can be diagnostically challenging due to their relative unfamiliarity.
